input.purpose: Text typed into a field. Never below 16px.

motion.name: colour-transition
motion.purpose: Button hover. Reduced motion collapses every transition to 0.01ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one next action on a screen. Full width.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: none; border-radius: 0.875rem; padding: 12px 16px; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-pressed); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Every action that is not the one next step.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: none; border-radius: 0.875rem; padding: 12px 16px; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--rule); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, 16px text, border turns sage on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-input { border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 0.875rem; background: var(--surface); padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 1rem/1.5rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary); outline: none; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Feed type filter; a link, selected state is sage.
components.html: Smoke circle Edibles
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; border-radius: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-chip-on { background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat panel one tonal step above the field. No border, no shadow.
components.html:
Friday wind-down

South Tampa · 6 spots
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; border-radius: 1.125rem; background: var(--surface); padding: 16px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font: 600 1.125rem/1.75rem Fraunces, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-muted); }

components.name: Notice Card
components.description: A card whose text colour carries the tone: honey for warning or change.
components.html: Your card expires in 12 days. Renew it to keep full access.
components.css: .ds-notice { margin: 0; border-radius: 1.125rem; background: var(--surface); padding: 16px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--secondary); }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; border-radius: 0.875rem; background: var(--surface-2); padding: 4px; } .ds-seg-btn { border: none; border-radius: 0.875rem; background: transparent; padding: 6px 12px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-muted); cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-btn:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-seg-on { background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
A late-evening room lit by one lamp. The field is a warm brown-black, never a neutral or blue black. Text is cream, not white. The single living colour is a soft sage, used for the one thing to do next. Honey-gold is the second voice, kept for strain tags, notices and small accents. Headings are set in Fraunces, a warm serif with a slight softness; everything else is Inter.

The system is calm and quiet on purpose. It is used on a phone, often at night, often where someone might glance at the screen. Nothing glows, nothing shouts, and nothing looks like cannabis branding. Depth comes from stepping the surface a shade lighter, not from shadows. Shapes are generously rounded, so the app reads as soft and friendly rather than as a tool.

Dark is the default and the design reference. Light mode ("paper") uses the same token names, re-pointed, and is a full theme, not an afterthought.
keyCharacteristics: Warm brown-black field, cream ink, one sage action colour.
Serif headings (Fraunces) over a neutral sans body (Inter).
Flat surfaces; depth by tonal steps.
Big rounded cards, fat rounded controls.
Every colour comes from a token; both themes swap at runtime.

rules.name: The One File Rule
rules.body: A colour value is written only in app/globals.css. No oklch(), hex or rgb() inline in a component. One inline colour breaks a theme.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Sage marks the single next action on a screen. Two sage buttons side by side means one of them should be quiet.

rules.name: The Warm Black Rule
rules.body: The field is never neutral black (#000) or a cool grey. The warmth is the identity.

rules.name: The Serif Is For Headings Rule
rules.body: h1–h3 get Fraunces from globals.css. Nothing else does — not buttons, not labels, not numbers.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Lift a surface by making it a shade lighter, never by adding a shadow. Shadows on a warm-black field read as muddy.

dos: Do use token classes (bg-surface, text-ink, bg-primary) for every colour.
Do keep one Sage action per screen; make the rest Quiet.
Do step surfaces lighter (Warm Night → Ember Card → Ember Raised) to show depth.
Do use 1rem type in every field.
Do check both themes; light is a full theme.
Do add a visible :focus-visible treatment when you touch a button or link.
donts: Don't write oklch(), hex or rgb() in a component.
Don't use neutral black, cool grey, neon green or hot green.
Don't use Fraunces for anything but headings.
Don't use Honey as a button fill.
Don't use cannabis imagery or leaf icons as decoration.
Don't propose a new look here. The beauty pass is Plan 08, and it keeps Warm Ink.
